actions.admin_model_upsert: saved a model in the catalog
actions.admin_solution_log: added a note to a solution request
actions.app_connection_accept: accepted a connection request from another app
actions.app_connection_reject: rejected a connection request from another app
actions.app_connection_request: requested a connection to another app
actions.app_group_member_add: added an app to a group
actions.app_group_member_leave: took an app out of a group
actions.app_group_member_remove: removed an app from a group
actions.app_group_request_accept: accepted a request to join a group
actions.app_group_request_decline: declined a request to join a group
actions.app_group_visibility_request: requested a visibility change for an app group
actions.app_visibility_request: requested a visibility change for the app
actions.audit_export_webhook_rotate: rotated the audit export signing secret
actions.execution_board_reject: rejected a flow run before it started
actions.execution_event_reject: rejected an event run before it started
actions.route_reassign: pointed a route at another event
actions.sink_toggle: switched a sink on or off

anchoringStalledHint: Seals should be signed into an epoch every {{interval}}. Check that the audit worker is running and can use its signing key.
appPageDescription: Every administrative change to this app, sealed into a tamper-evident chain. Records appear at once and are sealed within minutes.
chainIdPlaceholder: platform, an app id, or <app id>#activity
checkedEarlier: Seals before #{{seq}} were verified by a previous check on this server, or pruned.
checkedNone: No seals after #{{seq}} to check. Earlier seals were verified by a previous check on this server, or pruned.
copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
exportDescription: Keep this app's audit trail longer than the platform does: every anchored seal and its records are delivered to your SIEM or storage within minutes.
headArchivedHint: That epoch left the database. Check it against the monthly archive.
headCheckInvalid: Expected JSON with an epoch sequence and a 64-character hex hash, and a well-formed seal if the head has one.
headCheckPlaceholder: Paste a saved head as JSON
headDescription: The newest anchored seal and the signed epoch that covers it. Keep a copy outside the platform to detect a rewritten history later.
headDiffersHint: The timeline was truncated or rewritten after this head was saved.
headFailed: Could not load the chain head.
headNone: No anchored seal yet. The audit worker anchors new seals within minutes when an audit signing key is configured.
heldChainsHint: A seal of these chains failed its hash or MAC check. They are not signed into epochs until an operator investigates; verify each chain to find the failing seal.
integrityDescription: Recomputes every record hash, seal link and epoch signature of this chain.
lockedDescription: Only owners of this app can read its audit trail.
navDescription: Tamper-evident record of every change, and its export
noActivityRecords: No activity records. Activity is kept for a shorter window than evidence.
noAppRecords: Nothing has been recorded for this app yet.
noRecords: No records in this chain yet.
noRecordsInPeriod: No matching records in this period.
noSealedChains: No chain has been sealed yet.
pullDescription: Fetch anchored seals and their records as NDJSON with an owner's access token. Pass the X-FlowLike-Audit-Next-Seq response header as after_seq to read the next page.
recordsFailed: Could not load the audit records.
recordsRefreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing the records loaded earlier.
redactedHint: The value expired under the retention policy. Its commitment still verifies.
removeDescription: Delivery stops and the delivery position is lost. A new webhook starts again from the oldest record still in the platform.
reportHeld: A seal of this chain failed its hash or MAC check. The chain is not signed into an epoch until an operator investigates.
reportRedactedHint: Expired IP addresses and details are reported as redacted: their commitments still verify.
reportUnverifiableEpochs: {{epochs}} epochs were signed with a key this server cannot verify. Add its public key to AUDIT_VERIFYING_KEYS.
rotateDescription: Deliveries are signed with the new secret right away. Update your receiver before the next delivery.
secretOnce: Copy this signing secret now. It is shown only once.
signatureHint: Each delivery carries X-FlowLike-Audit-Timestamp and X-FlowLike-Audit-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<body>" with your secret>.
statusInvalidHint: Failed its integrity check before sealing and was quarantined.
statusPendingHint: Recorded and protected by a MAC; it joins a seal within minutes.
statusSealedHint: Part of a seal: any later change breaks verification.
statusUnavailable: Audit status is unavailable. Retry to check the audit worker.
verifyFailed: Could not verify this chain. Try again.
webhookDisabledHint: Delivery stopped after repeated failures. Fix the endpoint, then switch delivery back on.
webhookHttpHint: Plain http is only accepted by deployments that allow it for local development.
webhookLoadFailed: Could not load the export settings.
widgetDescription: Records are sealed per chain, anchored in signed epochs and archived monthly.
